outcome_independence: no function in this module accepts an accepted-count, a quality score, a q value, a prior tranche's result, target data, or any other observed outcome as an input; membership is a pure function of (fold_id, tranche, route, recipe_ordinal, arm) only
route_assignment: BLOCK: within one tranche's 512 new positions, the first 256 (by position order) are PHYSICS, the next 256 are GPAT
shuffle_policy: the core RND/DET/LLM anchor bank must reach a common matched-feasible profile BEFORE Shuffle-A is evaluated for that fold; this amendment does not implement Shuffle reserve as an independent rescue mechanism; EXT-F1's historical Shuffle scientific infeasibility (BLOCKED_TRUE_FROZEN_MATCHED_BANK_INFEASIBILITY) is NOT rescued by it
synchronization_rule: a reserve tranche is ALWAYS built for all three RND/DET/LLM arms and both routes together, via materialize_reserve_schedule_for_fold -- this module exposes no API to build a partial (single-arm or single-route) tranche
v1_0_pool_invariance: positions 0..2047 are never produced, touched, or renumbered by this module; reserve positions occupy 2048.. exclusively (RESERVE_POSITION_BASE)
